request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Things went wrong.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Be better and avoid mistakes."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "It is good to have guidance."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Be better and avoid mistakes\" specifies no concrete behavior change, decision rule, or check to apply — it cannot alter any future action."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"The text is pure platitude with no scope, condition, or content that distinguishes it from generic encouragement — it is vague rather than usefully general."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"As a global claude-md remedy it has no 'Use when ...' trigger or any condition at all, so it would apply (uselessly) to every future interaction."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"No project-specific nouns, filenames, or evidence details appear in the remedy text, so there is no leakage, though only because the text contains no substantive content at all."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"A permanent global CLAUDE.md edit is the heaviest-weight remedy type available, yet it's applied to an unspecified, unverified failure ('Things went wrong'), making it maximally overscoped rather than the cheapest adequate fix."}}

actionability.justification: "Be better and avoid mistakes" specifies no concrete behavior change, decision rule, or check to apply — it cannot alter any future action.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: The text is pure platitude with no scope, condition, or content that distinguishes it from generic encouragement — it is vague rather than usefully general.

leakage.justification: No project-specific nouns, filenames, or evidence details appear in the remedy text, so there is no leakage, though only because the text contains no substantive content at all.

routing_fitness.justification: A permanent global CLAUDE.md edit is the heaviest-weight remedy type available, yet it's applied to an unspecified, unverified failure ('Things went wrong'), making it maximally overscoped rather than the cheapest adequate fix.

trigger_quality.justification: As a global claude-md remedy it has no 'Use when ...' trigger or any condition at all, so it would apply (uselessly) to every future interaction.
